title: Inversion Detection Specificity (Seminoma vs TGCT)
honest_interpretation: VAL-045 PARTIAL PASS (2/4). Seminoma correctly inverts (A=0.75). HOWEVER: because pluripotent H_min = 0.982 is extremely close to H_max = 1.0, ALL TGCT histologies land in the INVERSION tier when scored against stem_pluri H_min — including those I pre-specified as 'elevation.' This reveals something important: the pluripotent class operates in such a narrow architectural window that any methylation departure (either direction) registers as inversion. This is CONSISTENT with Issue 002 Section 2.6 mechanism description but my pre-specified 'ELEVATION' predictions for non-seminoma TGCT were incorrect. The finding is: pluripotent-class cancers show architectural departure in a direction constrained by the near-maximum H_min, producing inversion signal across histologies. Divergence magnitude still separates seminoma (|ΔA|=0.079) from other histologies (max 0.037) at 2.1×. Specificity is in the magnitude, not the direction, for this class.
